summary: Phase 2 backend + frontend validated. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing across CEP lookup, project PUT, multi-store offers, cart CRUD, alerts CRUD, and Phase-1 regression. Frontend: full mobile flow at 390x844 works — login, CEP save from Home (persists via AsyncStorage and Home reflects 'São Paulo · SP'), Builder chips + room templates, Plan2D canvas renders with tap-to-select room, dimension nudge controls (+/-0.5m), Save layout triggers PUT /api/projects/{id}, Offers renders partner stores (Leroy Merlin, C&C, Telhanorte) even when Mercado Livre API is 403 (retry UI shown), Cart empty state has 'Explorar ofertas' CTA. Tab bar navigation between home/builder/offers/cart works. No react-native red screens; no deprecated packages detected.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise offer-add-{id} via UI because Mercado Livre API returned no offers (external 403). Backend cart flow verified via pytest with a synthetic offer. Not a bug in the app.

action_items: None blocking. When ML API stabilises, revisit end-to-end 'offer → cart' UI verification (backend path is already covered).
Optional: Home currently displays 'City · UF' after CEP save; consider also showing the 8-digit CEP number in the label so users can visually confirm the exact CEP saved.
critical_code_review_comments: Mercado Livre integration is real, not mocked; graceful fallback (partner deep-links + retry card) is correctly implemented.
PUT /api/projects/{id} correctly persists x/y/width/length and validates ownership (404 on unknown id).
Cart aggregation returns grand_total = price*qty + freight and stores unique per (user_id, offer_id) with upsert.
CEP endpoint validates 8 digits and maps UF → freight_base/days via FREIGHT_TABLE.
seed_data_creation: Test project 'TEST_phase2_layout' created and updated via PUT; test cart items and alerts created and cleaned up in the same run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use demo@constroifacil.app / senha123 on https://build-discount-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend URL exposed as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Mercado Livre may 403; that is expected and the app renders partner deep-links plus a retry card. New endpoints exercised: GET /api/cep/{cep}, PUT /api/projects/{id}, GET/POST/DELETE /api/cart, GET/POST/DELETE /api/alerts, GET /api/offers with partner_stores. There is no Alerts tab in the tab bar yet — the Home 'alerts' tile currently has no handler (backend-only feature this iteration).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs surfaced. The single UI limitation (add-to-cart from offer card) is caused by the upstream Mercado Livre API rate-limiting and is already covered by pytest-level cart CRUD tests.
